title: CCTV PPE Compliance Detection Dataset (synthetic sample)
description:
Synthetic fixed-CCTV images of workers on construction sites, in warehouses and in workshops, whose hard hats, hi-vis vests and gloves are worn correctly, worn wrongly (hat held or set down, chin strap loose, worn backwards; vest open or tied around the waist) or missing (cap, beanie or bare head; orange clothing that is not hi-vis; bare hands). 200 images (46 in night infrared) with 2012 bounding boxes in 9 classes (person, hardhat, hardhat_wrong, no_hardhat, vest, vest_wrong, no_vest, gloves, no_gloves), in YOLO and COCO format.

The images are fully synthetic: no real people and no real sites. Each image was generated to a scene and camera specification, labelled automatically, checked by a vision-language model and visually reviewed. The sample is intended for research on PPE compliance detection from surveillance viewpoints. No model has been trained or benchmarked on it.
